The shield crab does not leave his shell unless it is forced to, 
and even then, it knows to keep its distance.

lines.name: Atziri's Reign
lines.flavourText:
Atziri went to great lengths to ensure her immortality,
but nothing is eternal.

lines.name: Brute Force Solution
lines.flavourText:
Picking a lock takes an immense amount of skill and practice.
Breaking it with a hammer takes about three seconds.

lines.name: Chill of Corruption
lines.flavourText:
Even a millennium later, Atziri's presence
casts a shroud over Wraeclast.

lines.name: Dead Reckoning

explicitModifiers.text: Skeletons gain Added Chaos Damage equal to (20-30)% of Maximum Energy Shield on your Equipped Shield

lines.flavourText:
A mage from the coast rode up on a broken nag, legs burnt to his bones.
Before he collapsed, he uttered:
"I watched the world we know end yesterday."

lines.name: Efficient Training
lines.flavourText: Working smart and working hard aren't mutually exclusive.

lines.name: Energised Armour
lines.flavourText: "I've yet to see prayer stop an arrow."

lines.name: Fertile Mind
lines.flavourText:
"The swallow flew fast and took many turns,
spilling a seed where no plant had grown before. 
This seed grew and grew until the desert became fertile and abundant. 
Your mind is like this seed." 
- Maraketh Proverb

lines.name: Fevered Mind
lines.flavourText: In sickness, the insane becomes sane.

lines.name: Fluid Motion
lines.flavourText: Even the strongest of steel can be made to bend.

lines.name: Hidden Potential
lines.flavourText:
The difference between the master and his apprentice
is what they see when they look at the same block of wood.

lines.name: Inertia
lines.flavourText: There is no force without movement.

lines.name: Pacifism
lines.flavourText: "Your fear will overcome you."

lines.name: Powerlessness
lines.flavourText: "Your desires will mislead you."

lines.name: Reckless Defence
lines.flavourText:
There's no motivation for genius
quite like desperation.

lines.name: Self-Flagellation
lines.flavourText: Beg for forgiveness.

lines.name: To Dust
lines.flavourText:
In the end, time comes for all of us.
For some, it comes much sooner.

lines.name: Tempered Mind

explicitModifiers.text: -1 Intelligence per 1 Intelligence on Allocated Passives in Radius
2% increased Mana Recovery Rate per 10 Intelligence on Allocated Passives in Radius

lines.flavourText: Any thought, no matter how fleeting, changes the thinker.

lines.name: The Siege

explicitModifiers.text: Adds Kineticism

lines.flavourText:
As the dead battered Highgate's barricades,
The Black Sekhema accepted her fate,
And stood her ground.

lines.name: Split Personality
lines.flavourText: You need not go looking for a second opinion.

lines.name: Firesong

explicitModifiers.text: +(10-15)% to Fire Resistance
Modifiers to Ignite Duration on you apply to all Elemental Ailments

lines.flavourText:
Within a firestorm, the Thane commands the flames
Emblazoned by glory and the song of the First Ones
For the master of fire fears nothing.

lines.name: Witchbane

explicitModifiers.text: +(5-15) to Intelligence

When you Kill an Enemy Cursed with a Non-Aura Hex, become Immune to
Curses for remaining Hex Duration

lines.flavourText:
In darkest night, 'neath waxen moon
A witch snatches a boy from his room.
He wards off her hexes
The witch he perplexes
And so becomes part of her stew.

lines.name: Replica Pacifism
lines.flavourText:
"Release the type Delta test subjects. Unseal all prototype lockers.
Arm yourself! I know that, as researchers, you've never had to fight
before, but they're coming to kill us all. It's resist or die!"
- Lead Researcher Ksaret, two hours post-Incident

lines.name: Replica Powerlessness
lines.flavourText:
"The suppression troops have stopped responding to my orders.
I'm no longer in charge, and I likely never truly was... I suspect
they're already coming for us."
- Lead Researcher Ksaret, one hour post-Incident

lines.name: Foulborn The Green Dream

explicitModifiers.text:
Passives granting Cold Resistance or all Elemental Resistances in Radius
also grant an equal chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on Kill

mutatedModifiers.text: Cold Damage with Hits is Lucky if you've Suppressed Spell Damage Recently

lines.flavourText:
We climb like vines up Chayula's arms,
reaching into the world that should be ours.

Passive Skills grown are influenced by Oils used when Anointing

lines.flavourText:
From unassuming seed sprang a putrefying plague –
consigning its host to death, and supplanting their very being.

The liquid within boils and fumes,
ready to erupt at any provocation.

lines.flavourText: New life will follow, but first come the flames.

lines.name: The Original Scripture

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge drops the Original Sin
Cannot have Inspiration
Maximum Resolve is 1
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 83
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "It's all here. The lie at the core of my faith. Maxarius was not the first chosen of Innocence. Maxarius was Innocence himself. A charlatan, a liar, and a power-seeker." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Gilded Chalice

explicitModifiers.text: Duplicates up to 4 random Offer Rewards upon defeating the Herald of the Scourge
Cannot recover Resolve
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 75
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "He took the newcomers' symbol and made it his own. Finally, they flocked to him. Finally, he had the power and wealth he so desired." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Hour of Divinity

explicitModifiers.text: Duplicates up to 2 random Offer Rewards upon defeating the Herald of the Scourge
Cannot have Boons
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "They ascended together, one unwillingly. The vilified became black as coal, and the lauded, golden. After a lifetime of ambition, he finally had his heart's desire. It only cost him his brother." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Blood of Innocence

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge drops the Balance of Terror
The Herald of the Scourge deals 50% more Damage
The Herald of the Scourge takes 50% less Damage
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "After weeks of being pursued, the veiled traveller made her stand in a sandstorm. Somehow, she wounded a god. Innocence relented; his brother and the traveller made good their escape." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Second Sacrament

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge deals 100% more Damage
The Herald of the Scourge takes 75% less Damage
The Herald of the Scourge drops the Winds of Fate
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 83
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "He took many of his people's traditions and gilded them, hollowed them. They rejected his new religion, and he and his followers were forced to depart the mountains for lands unknown." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Chains of Castigation

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge drops Sandstorm Visage
Rooms are unknown on the Sanctum Map
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 75
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "The mysterious traveller saw the vilified brother chained to a cliff, where all could point and shout and deride him. In one fell swing, she cracked the mountainside, freeing him." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The First Crest

explicitModifiers.text: Aureus Coins are converted to Relics upon defeating the Herald of the Scourge
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "In pursuit of divinity, he tried many times to found a religion. Few followed his initial symbols and proverbs. He needed something greater. A symbol none could deny." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The First Crest

explicitModifiers.text: Aureus Coins are converted to Experience upon defeating the Herald of the Scourge
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "In pursuit of divinity, he tried many times to found a religion. Few followed his initial symbols and proverbs. He needed something greater. A symbol none could deny." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The First Crest

explicitModifiers.text: Aureus Coins are converted to Tainted Currency upon defeating the Herald of the Scourge
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "In pursuit of divinity, he tried many times to found a religion. Few followed his initial symbols and proverbs. He needed something greater. A symbol none could deny." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Power and the Promise

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge drops Eternal Damnation
Cannot have Inspiration
Cannot recover Resolve
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 80
This item is destroyed when applied to a Sanctum

lines.flavourText: "Building on the fear and hatred that deified him, Innocence threatened an eternity of flames for nonbelievers. The newcomers wailed and threw themselves at his feet in the thousands." - Lycia, the Heretic

lines.name: The Broken Censer

explicitModifiers.text: The Herald of the Scourge drops 2 additional Forbidden Tomes
Rooms are unknown on the Sanctum Map
Cannot be used with Forbidden Tomes below level 75

lines.name: Incandescent Invitation
lines.flavourText:
From the corona of an ancient star,
the Searing Exarch seeks to master the Atlas.

lines.name: Screaming Invitation
lines.flavourText:
From the heart of the Tangle, the Eater of Worlds
reaches out for control of the Atlas.

lines.name: Writhing Invitation
lines.flavourText:
The Infinite Hunger awaits in a cosmic stomach where
whole civilisations are digested - but do not die.

lines.name: Polaric Invitation
lines.flavourText:
Once within the grasp of the Black Star,
there can be no escape.

lines.name: Goliath Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"This land was always harsh and brutal,
ever seeking ways to kill and maim us.
We had to grow and change to survive,
but each clan had its own ideas how..."

lines.name: Fenumal Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The Spiders that had been driven
back by the Blue Knight now sought
peace and cooperation. It was said
that Fenumus had commanded it."

lines.name: Taurus Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The first city was completed, and others sprouted.
The clans came together to declare Lysanda of Myr
the Queen. Henceforth, they became known as the
Ezomytes of Myr, and their numbers swelled."

lines.name: Carrion Queen Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Romance never interested Queen Lysanda,
but her advisors insisted heirs were needed.
To spite them, she took the Hag's only son as
her Consort - a quiet, pale, and strange man."

lines.name: Gargantuan Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"We held our trust in the First Ones long
before we learned runes. Long before we
were shown the ways of cities and roads."

lines.name: Flame Hellion Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Against the Winter Curse, only the forges of
runesmiths could stand. The people huddled,
shoulder to shoulder, while those within were
pressed against the fires, screaming in agony."

lines.name: Fugitive Ring
lines.flavourText: We will seize back our wayward Dream.

lines.name: Cobra Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Each new valley, each new grove, held new
dangers. Many Knights paid the price. Lysanda
had never been known for her beauty, but she
bore a new scar each season, earned gladly."

lines.name: Rhex Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"There began an eternal summer, as the
daughters of the Hag perfected their mastery
of the Tower. The forests became as gardens.
The hungry had only to pick a fruit and eat."

lines.name: Wolf Alpha Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"With the Winter Curse held at bay, Lysanda
and her Knights pursued the fell power that
had sent it... a Hag who made her lair in a
Tower that was ancient beyond ancient."

Ezomytes of Myr, and their numbers swelled."

lines.name: Watcher Talisman
lines.flavourText:

united, and they did love Lysanda, but some
men must go their own way. Those that braved
the inland sea settled the Isles of Skothe."

lines.flavourText: Metallic thoughts whisper in the dark.

lines.name: Hybrid Arachnid Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Twenty-two years into Lysanda's reign, the
Spiders swarmed from out of the dark. Her
Knights were ill-equipped for this foe, and
the people fled in droves, seeking safety."

lines.name: Blood Viper Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Those that departed sought the way of
cities and roads. Theirs would be a path
fraught with danger and hardship, as they
set out to find and build a new home."

lines.name: Magma Hound Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"They bound the Hag of the Winter Curse
and set her alight, to no avail. Her cackle
was gleeful and wicked. Even if they slew
her, she boasted, she had many daughters..."

lines.name: Scorpion Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"But there were some who could not forget
the horrors of the Winter Curse, and of the
Hag that had sent it. Alasdair dropped his
wine goblet, and fell to the ground, choking."

lines.name: Enthalpic Ring
lines.flavourText: The embers of the Red Pyre yet glow.

lines.name: Croaker Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Ezomyr grew on a foundation of
choice. Its climate was chosen. Its
animals were chosen. For once,
Wraeclast was not harsh, but kind."

lines.name: Saqawine Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The skies were clear and blue, yet
brought rains when needed. It was
said that the people had proven
themselves to Saqawal and his flocks."

lines.name: Gargantuan Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"We held our trust in the First Ones long
before we learned runes. Long before we
were shown the ways of cities and roads."

lines.name: Lynx Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The night refused to end, and the Winter Curse
howled. The people wailed, and Lysanda raged.
It was then that the sky tore open, unleashing
a saviour fury... at the behest of the Druids."

lines.name: Chieftain Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"I know where we found our belief in
the First Ones. I see it every time I walk
the untouched forests and hills. The
primordial world is still here. With us."

lines.name: Flame Hellion Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Against the Winter Curse, only the forges of
runesmiths could stand. The people huddled,
shoulder to shoulder, while those within were
pressed against the fires, screaming in agony."

lines.name: Ape Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The Druids emerged from the forests to greet
and warn the new settlers. This was an ancient
land full of mysteries and dangers. Lysanda sent
her best men to study and learn with them."

lines.name: Black Widow Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The Royal Wedding of Lysanda of Myr
lasted for a full month. The hunts were
vigorous, and the meat and drink flowed
freely for all. There was much rejoicing."

lines.name: Octopus Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"The Blue Knight stood against the swarm,
icy and unassailable. His identity was not
known, and he never removed his helmet.
Glimpses were caught of piercing blue eyes."

lines.name: Rhoa Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"A great rift formed, between clans,
between families. Those that remained
resolved to endure times of struggle,
if it meant we could keep our ways."

lines.name: Goliath Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"This land was always harsh and brutal,
ever seeking ways to kill and maim us.
We had to grow and change to survive,
but each clan had its own ideas how..."

lines.name: Shield Crab Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Those that swore loyalty to Lysanda, that
forged ahead with her to clear the way.
became known as the first Knights...
armoured, battered, and courageous."

lines.name: Devourer Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"A great headless monstrosity with arms like
teeth stalked the lands they hoped to settle.
No other weapon would find purchase. They
surrounded it with fire, burning it for days."

lines.name: Pitbull Talisman
lines.flavourText:
"Lysanda roared, and hacked the Hag apart
limb by limb, not stopping until the deed
was done. Her daughters, however, were
spared... and tasked with service and duty."
